verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is delivered entirely as an HTTP API (r.jina.ai / s.jina.ai) with extensive documented headers/parameters (x-respond-with, x-preset, x-engine, x-json-schema, x-instruction, x-markdown-chunking, etc.), curl examples, and even a 'code builder' tool to explore parameter combinations, making it highly amenable to agentic/programmatic use. Missing for 10: a discoverable formal OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found all candidate paths 404) and an llms.txt, so machine-discoverability of the API contract is weaker than ideal, though the API itself is thoroughly documented.
